title: Rudraksha guide: which mukhi to wear, and how to spot fakes | Ask Tota
description: Rudraksha beads are seeds of the Elaeocarpus tree, counted by mukhi, the natural lines. The planet linked to each mukhi, how to choose, wear and verify one.
og_title: Rudraksha guide: mukhis, planets and fakes
og_description: From one mukhi to fourteen: what each is traditionally linked to, why five mukhi is the everyday bead, and how to avoid the most common fakes.
h1: rudraksha, explained: what the mukhis mean and how not to buy a fake
dek: a rudraksha is the dried seed of a tree, counted by the natural lines on its surface. each count, or mukhi, is traditionally linked to a deity and a planet. the five mukhi bead is the everyday one. the rare ones are where most of the fakes live.
card_title: rudraksha, explained: what the mukhis mean and how not to buy a fake
card_dek: seeds of a tree, counted by their natural lines. the planet linked to each mukhi, why five mukhi is the everyday bead, and how fakes work.
llms_desc: what rudraksha beads are (seeds of Elaeocarpus ganitrus), what mukhi means, the deity and planet traditionally linked to one to fourteen mukhi beads, why five mukhi is most common, how to choose and wear rudraksha, how fakes are made and verified (X-ray, not the water test), and how rudraksha differs from gemstones.

faq.a: the dried seed of the rudraksha tree, elaeocarpus ganitrus, which grows in the himalayan foothills, nepal and southeast asia, especially indonesia. the name joins rudra, a name of shiva, and aksha, eye or tear.

faq.q: what does mukhi mean in rudraksha?
faq.a: mukhi means face. it refers to the natural vertical lines or clefts running from top to bottom of the bead. a five mukhi bead has five lines. the count is what determines the bead's traditional meaning.

faq.q: which rudraksha is best for everyone?
faq.a: the five mukhi, linked to shiva as kalagni rudra and to jupiter in the common planetary mapping. it is by far the most common, inexpensive, and traditionally considered safe for anyone to wear.

faq.q: which rudraksha is for which planet?
faq.a: the common modern mapping is: 1 mukhi sun, 2 moon, 3 mars, 4 mercury, 5 jupiter, 6 venus, 7 saturn, 8 rahu, 9 ketu. traditions differ slightly, especially above nine.

round one mukhi beads from nepal are extremely rare. most beads sold as one mukhi are half moon shaped varieties from south india or elsewhere, or are carved fakes. be very cautious of any one mukhi offered at a modest price.

faq.q: how do i check if a rudraksha is real?
faq.a: the reliable method is an x-ray or ct scan from a reputable lab, which shows internal compartments matching the number of mukhis. the popular water floating test and the copper coin spinning test are not reliable.
traditionally yes, regardless of gender, age or religion. unlike gemstones, rudraksha is generally not considered to have harmful side effects, which is part of why five mukhi is so widely worn.

faq.q: how should i wear a rudraksha?
faq.a: traditionally on a red or yellow thread or a silver or gold chain, touching the skin, after a simple energising with water and a shiva mantra such as om namah shivaya. monday is a traditional day to start.

faq.q: what is the difference between nepali and indonesian rudraksha?
faq.a: nepali beads are larger, with deeper, clearer mukhis. indonesian beads are smaller and smoother, often used in malas. both are the same genus. price differences are mostly about size, clarity and rarity.

they work on different logics. gemstones are said to amplify a planet, so the tradition prescribes them carefully. rudraksha is treated as devotional and protective with few cautions. neither has scientific evidence of effect.

faq.q: how many beads are in a rudraksha mala?
faq.a: 108 plus one, the guru or sumeru bead. 108 is the traditional number for japa, mantra repetition, and also 27 nakshatras times 4 padas.
there is no solid scientific evidence for health or astrological effects. many people value rudraksha as a devotional object and a reminder of practice, which is a perfectly good reason to wear one.
